entities.summary: Nabeshima Naomasa  was the 10th and final daimyō of Saga Domain in Hizen Province, Kyūshū, Japan. His honorary title was Hizen-no-Kami, and he was occasionally referred to as “Prince Hizen” in Western accounts during the Bakumatsu period.
